newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine T-bill yields fall at auction.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine T-bill yields fall at auction.

text.p: Average yields at auctions of six-month, nine-month and 12-month Ukraine discount treasury bills edged down from previous sales, a central bank statement said on Wednesday.
Six-month bills edged down to 21.00 percent from 23.55 percent, nine-month bills edged down to 27.91 percent from 28.89 percent and 12-month bills slipped to 32.56 percent from 32.87 percent.
Results of six-month T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 9.00 million UAH 7.00 million UAH
Amount sold 9.00 million UAH 7.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 8.15 million UAH 6.26 million UAH
The central bank sold 90,000 T-bills, the bank statement said. Of those, 40,000 were competitive and 50,000 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for May 29.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 23.00 million UAH 24.00 million UAH
Amount sold 10.05 million UAH 5.19 million UAH
Actual amount raised 8.32 million UAH 4.27 million UAH
The central bank sold 100,546 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 93,605 were competitive and 6,941 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for May 29.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 31.00 million UAH 40.00 million UAH
Amount sold 31.00 million UAH 38.90 million UAH
Actual amount raised 23.40 million UAH 29.30 million UAH
The central bank sold 310,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 193,167 were competitive and 116,833 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for May 29.
